q.en: A collective noun for a group of lions is:

explanation.en: 'Pride' is the collective noun used for a group of lions.
explanation.as: সিংহৰ গোটৰ বাবে ব্যৱহৃত collective noun হৈছে 'pride'।

q.en: The man ___ helped me was very kind.
q.as: যি মানুহজনে মোক সহায় কৰিছিল তেওঁ বৰ দয়ালু আছিল।

explanation.en: 'Who' is used as the subject relative pronoun for a person.
explanation.as: ব্যক্তিৰ বাবে কৰ্তা হিচাপে relative pronoun 'who' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: The pen ___ I lost was new.

explanation.en: 'Which' is used for things, so 'the pen which I lost' is correct.
explanation.as: বস্তুৰ বাবে 'which' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়; সেয়ে 'the pen which I lost' শুদ্ধ।

q.en: He made ___ a cup of tea.
q.as: তেওঁ নিজৰ বাবে এক কাপ চাহ বনালে।

explanation.en: 'Himself' is the reflexive pronoun referring back to 'he'.
explanation.as: 'himself' reflexive pronoun য়ে 'he' লৈ উলটি সূচায়।

explanation.en: 'Ours' is the possessive pronoun that stands alone without a noun.
explanation.as: 'ours' হৈছে possessive pronoun, যি noun ৰ পিছত অকলে ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

explanation.en: For physical distance, the comparative degree of 'far' is 'farther'.
explanation.as: শাৰীৰিক দূৰত্বৰ বাবে 'far' ৰ তুলনামূলক ডিগ্ৰী 'farther'।

explanation.en: The superlative degree of 'many' is 'most'.
explanation.as: 'many' ৰ সৰ্বোচ্চ ডিগ্ৰী হৈছে 'most'।

explanation.en: The fixed phrase is 'on time', meaning at the expected time.
explanation.as: নিৰ্দিষ্ট বাক্যাংশ 'on time', যাৰ অৰ্থ হৈছে নিৰ্ধাৰিত সময়ত।

explanation.en: 'Or' joins two alternatives here: work hard, or else you will fail.
explanation.as: ইয়াত 'or' য়ে দুটা বিকল্প সংযোগ কৰে: পৰিশ্ৰম কৰা, নহ'লে ব্যৰ্থ হ'ব।

q.en: Neither Ram nor his friends ___ present.
q.as: ৰাম বা তেওঁৰ বন্ধুবৰ্শে ___ উপস্থিত নাছিল।

explanation.en: With 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject 'friends', so 'were' is used.
explanation.as: 'neither...nor' ৰ ক্ষেত্ৰত verb ই নিকটৱৰ্তী কৰ্তা 'friends' ৰ সৈতে মিলে; সেয়ে 'were' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: I ___ my homework before he came.
q.as: তেওঁ অহাৰ আগতে মই মোৰ গৃহকৰ্ম ___।

explanation.en: The past perfect 'had finished' shows an action completed before another past action.
explanation.as: past perfect 'had finished' য়ে আন এটা অতীত কাৰ্যৰ আগতে সম্পূৰ্ণ হোৱা কাৰ্য দেখুৱায়।

q.en: She ___ in this school for ten years.
q.as: তাই এই বিদ্যালয়ত দহ বছৰ ধৰি ___।

explanation.en: The present perfect continuous 'has been teaching' is used for an action continuing from the past until now.
explanation.as: অতীতৰ পৰা এতিয়ালৈকে চলি থকা কাৰ্যৰ বাবে present perfect continuous 'has been teaching' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: Change into passive voice: Someone stole my pen.
q.as: কৰ্মবাচ্যলৈ ৰূপান্তৰ কৰক: Someone stole my pen.

explanation.en: The simple past passive is formed with 'was/were' plus the past participle, so 'was stolen' is correct.
explanation.as: simple past ৰ কৰ্মবাচ্য 'was/were' আৰু past participle ৰে গঠিত; সেয়ে 'was stolen' শুদ্ধ।

q.en: Change into active voice: The song is being sung by her.
q.as: কৰ্তৃবাচ্যলৈ ৰূপান্তৰ কৰক: The song is being sung by her.

explanation.en: The present continuous passive 'is being sung' corresponds to the active 'is singing'.
explanation.as: present continuous ৰ কৰ্মবাচ্য 'is being sung' ৰ কৰ্তৃবাচ্য হৈছে 'is singing'।

q.en: Change into indirect speech: She said, 'I will come tomorrow.'
q.as: পৰোক্ষ উক্তিলৈ ৰূপান্তৰ কৰক: She said, 'I will come tomorrow.'

options.en: She said that she will come tomorrow.
options.as: She said that she will come tomorrow.

options.en: She said that she came tomorrow.
options.as: She said that she came tomorrow.

options.en: She says that she would come tomorrow.
options.as: She says that she would come tomorrow.

options.en: She said that she would come the next day.
options.as: She said that she would come the next day.

explanation.en: In indirect speech, 'will' changes to 'would' and 'tomorrow' changes to 'the next day'.
explanation.as: পৰোক্ষ উক্তিত 'will' 'would' লৈ আৰু 'tomorrow' 'the next day' লৈ সলনি হয়।

explanation.en: 'May' is used to ask for permission politely.
explanation.as: ভদ্ৰভাৱে অনুমতি বিচাৰিবলৈ 'may' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

explanation.en: A negative statement takes a positive question tag, so 'do they' is correct.
explanation.as: ঋণাত্মক বাক্যৰ সৈতে ধনাত্মক question tag লগে; সেয়ে 'do they' শুদ্ধ।

q.en: If I had studied hard, I ___ passed.
q.as: যদি মই কঠোৰ পৰিশ্ৰম কৰিলোহেঁতেন, মই ___ উত্তীৰ্ণ হ'লোহেঁতেন।

explanation.en: In the third conditional, the main clause uses 'would have' plus the past participle.
explanation.as: third conditional ত main clause ত 'would have' আৰু past participle ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

options.en: She is taller than her sister.
options.as: She is taller than her sister.

options.en: She is more tall than her sister.
options.as: She is more tall than her sister.

options.en: She is tallest than her sister.
options.as: She is tallest than her sister.

options.en: She is taller then her sister.
options.as: She is taller then her sister.

explanation.en: The comparative form is 'taller', and comparison uses 'than', not 'then' or 'more tall'.
explanation.as: তুলনামূলক ৰূপ 'taller' আৰু তুলনাত 'than' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়, 'then' বা 'more tall' নহয়।

explanation.en: 'Umbrella' begins with a vowel sound, so 'an' is used.
explanation.as: 'umbrella' ৰ উচ্চাৰণ স্বৰধ্বনিৰে আৰম্ভ হয়; সেয়ে 'an' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

explanation.en: 'The' is used before the names of sacred books.
explanation.as: পবিত্ৰ গ্ৰন্থৰ নামৰ আগত 'The' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

explanation.en: The plural of 'datum' is 'data'.
explanation.as: 'datum' ৰ বহুবচন হৈছে 'data'।

explanation.en: The plural of 'tooth' is 'teeth'.
explanation.as: 'tooth' ৰ বহুবচন হৈছে 'teeth'।

explanation.en: The abstract noun of 'free' is 'freedom'.
explanation.as: 'free' ৰ ভাৱবাচক বিশেষ্য হৈছে 'freedom'।

q.en: A collective noun for a group of bees is:

explanation.en: 'Swarm' is the collective noun used for a group of bees.
explanation.as: মৌমাখিৰ গোটৰ বাবে ব্যৱহৃত collective noun হৈছে 'swarm'।

explanation.en: 'Whose' is used to ask about possession.
explanation.as: মালিকানা সোধাৰ বাবে 'whose' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: He is the boy ___ father is a doctor.
q.as: তেওঁ সেই ল'ৰাটো যাৰ পিতৃ এজন চিকিৎসক।

explanation.en: 'Whose' shows possession and is used here for 'the boy's father'.
explanation.as: 'whose' য়ে মালিকানা দেখুৱায়; ইয়াত 'the boy's father' বুজাবলৈ ব্যৱহাৰ হৈছে।

explanation.en: The correct reflexive pronoun for 'they' is 'themselves'.
explanation.as: 'they' ৰ বাবে শুদ্ধ reflexive pronoun হৈছে 'themselves'।

q.en: Between you and ___, this is wrong.

explanation.en: After the preposition 'between', the objective pronoun 'me' is used.
explanation.as: preposition 'between' ৰ পিছত objective pronoun 'me' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

explanation.en: The comparative degree of 'good' is 'better'.
explanation.as: 'good' ৰ তুলনামূলক ডিগ্ৰী হৈছে 'better'।

explanation.en: The superlative degree of 'little' is 'least'.
explanation.as: 'little' ৰ সৰ্বোচ্চ ডিগ্ৰী হৈছে 'least'।

explanation.en: The correct preposition after 'angry' with a person is 'with'.
explanation.as: ব্যক্তিৰ সৈতে 'angry' ৰ পিছত শুদ্ধ preposition হৈছে 'with'।

explanation.en: 'Over' means across from one side to the other, which fits jumping across a fence.
explanation.as: 'over' মানে এফালৰ পৰা আনফাললৈ; বেৰৰ ওপৰেৰে জাঁপ মৰাৰ বাবে ই উপযুক্ত।

explanation.en: 'But' is used to join two contrasting ideas.
explanation.as: দুটা বিপৰীত ভাৱ সংযোগ কৰিবলৈ 'but' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

explanation.en: 'News' is an uncountable noun and takes the singular verb 'is'.
explanation.as: 'news' uncountable noun; সেয়ে ই singular verb 'is' লয়।

q.en: By next year, he ___ his degree.
q.as: অহা বছৰৰ ভিতৰত তেওঁ তেওঁৰ ডিগ্ৰী ___।

explanation.en: The future perfect 'will have completed' shows an action finished before a future time.
explanation.as: future perfect 'will have completed' য়ে ভৱিষ্যৎ সময়ৰ আগতে সম্পূৰ্ণ হোৱা কাৰ্য দেখুৱায়।

explanation.en: 'Look!' signals an action happening now, so the present continuous 'is crying' is used.
explanation.as: 'Look!' য়ে এতিয়া ঘটি থকা কাৰ্য বুজায়; সেয়ে present continuous 'is crying' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: Change into passive voice: They are painting the wall.
q.as: কৰ্মবাচ্যলৈ ৰূপান্তৰ কৰক: They are painting the wall.

explanation.en: The present continuous passive is formed with 'is/are being' plus the past participle.
explanation.as: present continuous ৰ কৰ্মবাচ্য 'is/are being' আৰু past participle ৰে গঠিত হয়।

q.en: Change into active voice: The work has been done by him.
q.as: কৰ্তৃবাচ্যলৈ ৰূপান্তৰ কৰক: The work has been done by him.

explanation.en: The present perfect passive 'has been done' corresponds to the active 'has done'.
explanation.as: present perfect ৰ কৰ্মবাচ্য 'has been done' ৰ কৰ্তৃবাচ্য হৈছে 'has done'।

q.en: Change into indirect speech: The teacher said to me, 'Open the door.'
q.as: পৰোক্ষ উক্তিলৈ ৰূপান্তৰ কৰক: The teacher said to me, 'Open the door.'

options.en: The teacher told me open the door.
options.as: The teacher told me open the door.

options.en: The teacher said me to open the door.
options.as: The teacher said me to open the door.

options.en: The teacher told me to open the door.
options.as: The teacher told me to open the door.

options.en: The teacher asked me open the door.
options.as: The teacher asked me open the door.

explanation.en: An imperative sentence is reported with 'told' plus 'to' and the base verb.
explanation.as: আদেশবাচক বাক্যৰ পৰোক্ষ উক্তিত 'told' আৰু 'to' ৰ সৈতে verb ৰ base form ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: He ___ speak English fluently when he was young.
q.as: তেওঁ ডেকা কালত ইংৰাজী অনৰ্গল ক'ব ___।

explanation.en: 'Could' is the past form of 'can' and shows past ability.
explanation.as: 'could' হৈছে 'can' ৰ অতীত ৰূপ আৰু ই অতীতৰ সামৰ্থ্য দেখুৱায়।

q.en: Let us go for a walk, ___?

explanation.en: A sentence beginning with 'Let us' takes the question tag 'shall we'.
explanation.as: 'Let us' ৰে আৰম্ভ হোৱা বাক্যৰ question tag হৈছে 'shall we'।

q.as: যদি তুমি বৰফ গৰম কৰা, ই ___।

explanation.en: A general truth is expressed in the zero conditional with the present simple 'melts'.
explanation.as: সাধাৰণ সত্য zero conditional ত present simple 'melts' ৰে প্ৰকাশ কৰা হয়।

q.en: Choose the correct sentence using 'one of':
q.as: 'one of' ব্যৱহাৰ কৰা শুদ্ধ বাক্যটো বাছক:

options.en: One of my friends is a doctor.
options.as: One of my friends is a doctor.

options.en: One of my friend are a doctor.
options.as: One of my friend are a doctor.

options.en: One of my friends are a doctor.
options.as: One of my friends are a doctor.

options.en: One of my friend is doctor.
options.as: One of my friend is doctor.

explanation.en: The phrase is 'one of my friends', and 'one' takes the singular verb 'is'.
explanation.as: বাক্যাংশটো 'one of my friends', আৰু 'one' য়ে singular verb 'is' লয়।

explanation.en: 'Honest' begins with a vowel sound because the 'h' is silent, so 'an' is used.
explanation.as: 'honest' ৰ 'h' নীৰৱ, সেয়ে ইয়াৰ উচ্চাৰণ স্বৰধ্বনিৰে আৰম্ভ হয়; সেয়ে 'an' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

explanation.en: No article is used before a proper name like Mahatma Gandhi.
explanation.as: মহাত্মা গান্ধীৰ দৰে ব্যক্তিনামৰ আগত কোনো article ব্যৱহাৰ নহয়।

explanation.en: The plural of 'cactus' is 'cacti'.
explanation.as: 'cactus' ৰ বহুবচন হৈছে 'cacti'।

explanation.en: The plural of 'sheep' is also 'sheep'.
explanation.as: 'sheep' ৰ বহুবচনও 'sheep'।

explanation.en: The abstract noun of 'know' is 'knowledge'.
explanation.as: 'know' ৰ ভাৱবাচক বিশেষ্য হৈছে 'knowledge'।

q.en: A collective noun for a group of stars is:

explanation.en: 'Constellation' is the collective noun used for a group of stars.
explanation.as: তৰাৰ গোটৰ বাবে ব্যৱহৃত collective noun হৈছে 'constellation'।

explanation.en: 'Myself' is used here as an emphatic pronoun to emphasise 'I'.
explanation.as: ইয়াত 'I' ক গুৰুত্ব দিবলৈ emphatic pronoun হিচাপে 'myself' ব্যৱহাৰ হৈছে।

q.en: The woman ___ we met is my aunt.
q.as: আমি লগ পোৱা মহিলাগৰাকী মোৰ মাহী।

explanation.en: 'Whom' is used as the object of the verb 'met'.
explanation.as: 'met' ক্ৰিয়াৰ object হিচাপে 'whom' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: ___ of the boys has done his homework.
q.as: ল'ৰাবোৰৰ ভিতৰত ___ য়ে নিজৰ গৃহকৰ্ম কৰিছে।

explanation.en: 'Each' is singular and takes the singular verb 'has', so 'Each of the boys has done' is correct.
explanation.as: 'Each' singular আৰু ই singular verb 'has' লয়; সেয়ে 'Each of the boys has done' শুদ্ধ।

explanation.en: 'His' is the possessive adjective used before the noun 'book'.
explanation.as: 'his' হৈছে possessive adjective, যি 'book' noun ৰ আগত ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

explanation.en: The comparative degree of 'bad' is 'worse'.
explanation.as: 'bad' ৰ তুলনামূলক ডিগ্ৰী হৈছে 'worse'।

explanation.en: The superlative degree of 'far' is 'farthest'.
explanation.as: 'far' ৰ সৰ্বোচ্চ ডিগ্ৰী হৈছে 'farthest'।

explanation.en: 'Since' is used with a point of time such as Monday.
explanation.as: সোমবাৰৰ দৰে সময়ৰ নিৰ্দিষ্ট বিন্দুৰ সৈতে 'since' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.as: তাই এজন চিকিৎসকৰ সৈতে বিবাহপাশত আবদ্ধ।

explanation.en: The correct preposition after 'married' is 'to'.
explanation.as: 'married' ৰ পিছত শুদ্ধ preposition হৈছে 'to'।

q.en: ___ he is poor, he is honest.

explanation.en: 'Although' introduces a contrast between being poor and being honest.
explanation.as: 'although' য়ে দুখীয়া আৰু সৎ হোৱাৰ মাজৰ বিপৰীত ভাৱ প্ৰকাশ কৰে।

explanation.en: 'Mathematics' is a singular subject despite its plural-looking form, so 'is' is used.
explanation.as: 'mathematics' দেখাত plural যেন লাগিলেও ই singular subject; সেয়ে 'is' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: She ___ the letter before I arrived.

explanation.en: The past perfect 'had written' shows that the action was completed before another past action.
explanation.as: past perfect 'had written' য়ে আন এটা অতীত কাৰ্যৰ আগতে কাৰ্য সম্পূৰ্ণ হোৱা দেখুৱায়।

explanation.en: The present perfect 'have lived' is used for a state continuing from a past point until now.
explanation.as: অতীতৰ নিৰ্দিষ্ট সময়ৰ পৰা এতিয়ালৈকে চলি থকা অৱস্থাৰ বাবে present perfect 'have lived' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: Change into passive voice: The teacher will explain the lesson.
q.as: কৰ্মবাচ্যলৈ ৰূপান্তৰ কৰক: The teacher will explain the lesson.

options.en: The lesson will be explained by the teacher.
options.as: The lesson will be explained by the teacher.

options.en: The lesson is explained by the teacher.
options.as: The lesson is explained by the teacher.

options.en: The lesson was explained by the teacher.
options.as: The lesson was explained by the teacher.

options.en: The lesson will explained by the teacher.
options.as: The lesson will explained by the teacher.

explanation.en: The future passive is formed with 'will be' plus the past participle.
explanation.as: ভৱিষ্যৎ কালৰ কৰ্মবাচ্য 'will be' আৰু past participle ৰে গঠিত হয়।

q.en: Change into active voice: The thief was caught by the police.
q.as: কৰ্তৃবাচ্যলৈ ৰূপান্তৰ কৰক: The thief was caught by the police.

options.en: The police has caught the thief.
options.as: The police has caught the thief.

options.en: The police were caught the thief.
options.as: The police were caught the thief.

explanation.en: The simple past passive 'was caught' corresponds to the active 'caught'.
explanation.as: simple past ৰ কৰ্মবাচ্য 'was caught' ৰ কৰ্তৃবাচ্য হৈছে 'caught'।

q.en: Change into indirect speech: He said, 'I have finished my work.'
q.as: পৰোক্ষ উক্তিলৈ ৰূপান্তৰ কৰক: He said, 'I have finished my work.'

options.en: He said that he has finished his work.
options.as: He said that he has finished his work.

options.en: He says that he had finished his work.
options.as: He says that he had finished his work.

options.en: He said that he finished his work.
options.as: He said that he finished his work.

options.en: He said that he had finished his work.
options.as: He said that he had finished his work.

explanation.en: The present perfect 'have finished' changes to the past perfect 'had finished' in indirect speech.
explanation.as: পৰোক্ষ উক্তিত present perfect 'have finished' 'had finished' লৈ সলনি হয়।

explanation.en: 'Must not' expresses a strong prohibition.
explanation.as: 'must not' য়ে কঠোৰ নিষেধাজ্ঞা প্ৰকাশ কৰে।

explanation.en: A positive statement takes a negative tag; the auxiliary is 'can', so the tag is 'can't he'.
explanation.as: ধনাত্মক বাক্যৰ সৈতে ঋণাত্মক tag লগে; auxiliary 'can', সেয়ে tag 'can't he'।

q.en: Unless you work hard, you ___ fail.
q.as: যদি তুমি পৰিশ্ৰম নকৰা, তুমি ব্যৰ্থ ___।

explanation.en: 'Unless' means 'if not', and the main clause of a first conditional uses 'will'.
explanation.as: 'unless' মানে 'যদি নহয়'; first conditional ৰ main clause ত 'will' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

options.en: He is more senior than me.
options.as: He is more senior than me.

explanation.en: 'Senior' is followed by 'to', not 'than' or 'from'.
explanation.as: 'senior' ৰ পিছত 'to' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়, 'than' বা 'from' নহয়।
